summary: Phase 3 testing (cancellation reason classification college/non_college + Prep Leave Periods + absence engine + teacher overtime). Backend: 15 pytest cases, 12 pass. Admin flows all work: /status and PUT /lectures/{id} persist cancellation_reason_type, reset to scheduled clears it, absent never persists it, an invalid value returns 400, the overtime report adds college_cancel_hours (shortfall 1.5 -> 0.5 with the note 'إلغاء بسبب الكلية', while non_college leaves shortfall unchanged), prep-leave CRUD and validation (400s, 404) work, and the absence engine drops executed lectures inside a course- or department-scope prep period (executed_hours goes back to baseline). The 3 failures share one root cause: the TEACHER role effectively has override_lecture_status, so a teacher can classify cancellations and can create/delete university-wide prep-leave periods. Frontend: the cancel modal works end to end on /schedule (badge 'بسبب الكلية' shown, DB persisted) and on /course-lectures. The /prep-leave-periods screen works (dashboard entry, add all/course scope, delete), but the date text inputs lose focus on every keystroke.

critical.issue: cancellation_reason_type is NOT stripped for teachers. The teacher's default permissions include MANAGE_LECTURES, which FULL_PERMISSION_MAPPING expands to OVERRIDE_LECTURE_STATUS, so has_permission(teacher, OVERRIDE_LECTURE_STATUS) is True. Reproduced: teacher180156 cancelled a lecture with type 'college' and it was persisted. Teachers can therefore wipe their own overtime shortfall.

Teacher gets 200 (expected 403) and can create or delete university-wide (scope=all) prep-leave periods. These forgive student absences for everyone. Same root cause: _can_manage() falls back to has_permission(OVERRIDE_LECTURE_STATUS). Student is correctly blocked with 403.

minor.issue: Teacher gets 200 on the override-status endpoint and can change the status of lectures in courses they don't own. teacher180156 changed a lecture of course 6ace901a… whose teacher is 698e533b…. This is not new to this phase but is now more impactful because of the college classification.

Two gaps: (1) cancellation_reason_type is only validated when status=cancelled. An admin sending it without a status (or with status=completed) persists any arbitrary or invalid value. (2) Setting status=absent only pops the field from the payload and does not clear an existing value ($set None), unlike /status. A lecture that was 'cancelled/college' and is then marked absent keeps 'college' in the DB.

college_cancel_hours are added to actual_hours/total_actual. This raises overtime_hours, bonus_hours and the overtime pay amount, not just removing the shortfall. If every lecture in the period is college-cancelled, expected=0 but actual=hours, so completion is 100% and the hours become paid overtime. If a college-cancelled lecture falls on an official holiday date, it can also be counted twice (holiday_hours + college_cancel_hours). Consider capping at expected, or reducing expected instead of inflating actual.

ui_bugs.issue: DateField is declared inside the component body, so it remounts on every render. Typing in the text field loses focus after each keystroke: typing '2031-05-01' char-by-char leaves only '2'. The native date input next to it still works. Fix: move DateField outside the component or inline the JSX.

integration_issues.issue: schedule.tsx canClassifyCancellation includes 'manage_lectures', and SideMenu shows 'إجازة التحضير' for 'manage_lectures'. Teachers therefore see the classification chips and the prep-leave menu entry. Align with the intended admin/dean/dept-head-only rule.

issues: Each date shows both a YYYY-MM-DD text box and a browser-default <input type=date> (two inputs per date, redundant). Use a single shadcn-style/custom date picker.
Modal stretches full width on desktop instead of a centered card (maxWidth)
The course picker lists courses from all semesters, so two 'دراسات حضرموت' entries appear. Filter by active semester or show the semester name.
Cancelled lectures do not show the 'بسبب الكلية/غير الكلية' badge (only /schedule shows it)

action_items: Restrict cancellation classification and prep-leave management to admin/dean/department_head. Don't rely on OVERRIDE_LECTURE_STATUS alone, because the teacher role gets it via MANAGE_LECTURES expansion. E.g. in PUT /lectures/{id}: if current_user.role == teacher, pop cancellation_reason_type. In prep_leave._can_manage, exclude teachers or use a dedicated permission.
Fix prep-leave-periods.tsx DateField focus loss (hoist the component outside the render function)
PUT /lectures/{id}: validate cancellation_reason_type for any status. Only persist it when status=cancelled. On status=absent, explicitly $set it to None.
Revisit the overtime calculation so college_cancel_hours do not inflate overtime pay or bonus, and do not double count with holidays
Frontend: hide the classification chips and the prep-leave menu entry from teachers (schedule.tsx canClassifyCancellation, SideMenu permissions)
critical_code_review_comments: prep_leave._can_manage: has_permission(OVERRIDE_LECTURE_STATUS) is True for teachers (MANAGE_LECTURES expansion), which is a security hole
server.py PUT /lectures/{id}: there is no ownership check for teachers on any lecture (pre-existing)

absence_engine.prep_excluded_dates expands each period day by day into a set. This is fine for short periods, but a large accidental range (years) is expanded with no cap. Consider comparing date strings against ranges instead.
prep_leave POST does not validate that scope_id exists (course/department/faculty) and does not check that a department head stays within their own department scope
